Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rohan - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rishabh - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Rohan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan knocks on the door.]

Rohan: "That's great!"

[Rohan opens the door and goes out.]

Rohan (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan slams the door shut.]

Neeta: "Careful!"

[Rohan opens the window.]

Neeta: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Rishabh stand near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Rohan (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Flower petals rain down on Rohan.]

Rohan: "What next?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Rohan (excited): "That was such a fun day!"
